supplements.title: Fermentation time Determines Anti-inflammatory and Osteoprotective Activity of Green Tea Kombucha in a Rat Model of Experimental Periodontitis.
supplements.summary: 4-day fermented green tea kombucha effectively reduced inflammation and bone loss in rats with periodontitis, without causing organ toxicity.

supplements.title: A new eudesmane type sesquiterpenoid from the stem bark of Aglaia pachyphylla with cytotoxic and anti-inflammatory activities.
supplements.summary: A new natural compound from Aglaia pachyphylla bark, phyllunone A, demonstrated significant anti-inflammatory activity against TNF-α without substantial cytotoxicity in breast cancer cells.

supplements.title: The Double-Edged Sword of Dioscorea bulbifera L.: Recent Advances in Its Pharmacological Benefits and Hepatotoxicity, and the Quest for Detoxification Strategies.
supplements.summary: While traditional Chinese medicine has long used Dioscorea bulbifera tubers for treating inflammatory conditions, the research highlights its complex medicinal potential with both therapeutic benefits and potential toxicity risks.

supplements.title: Xin-Jia-Tong-Xie-Yao-Fang restores the intestinal barrier to alleviate irritable bowel syndrome via microbial butyrate mediated PI3K/Akt pathway suppression.
supplements.summary: A traditional Chinese herbal formula (Xin-Jia-Tong-Xie-Yao-Fang) helps repair intestinal barriers in irritable bowel syndrome by reducing inflammation through gut microbiome changes.

supplements.title: U07, a novel oridonin derivative, targets polo-like kinase 4 (PLK4) to induce ferroptosis in gastric cancer cells.
supplements.summary: U07, a novel drug, targets PLK4 to trigger cell death in gastric cancer by promoting ferroptosis and reducing tumor growth.

supplements.title: Effects of crocetin, a constituent of saffron, on indomethacin-induced gastric ulcer and related anxiety-like behavior in rats.
supplements.summary: Crocetin, a saffron compound, reduced gastric ulcer damage and anxiety in rats by protecting against inflammation-induced tissue injury.

supplements.title: Renqingchangjue ameliorates MNNG-induced chronic atrophic gastritis by inhibiting the TNF/NF-κB/Caspase-3 axis.
supplements.summary: Renqingchangjue, a Tibetan herbal formula, reduces inflammation and cell damage in chronic atrophic gastritis by blocking key inflammatory pathways.

supplements.title: In silico analysis of plumbagin's interaction with caspase 9: unveiling its potential as an anti-NSCLS agent.
supplements.summary: Plumbagin shows promising potential as a targeted anti-NSCLC treatment by effectively binding to caspase-9 and demonstrating strong molecular interactions.

supplements.title: In silico approach to screen anti-inflammatory phytochemicals: targeting cytosolic phospholipase A2 and phospholipase C.
supplements.summary: p-Coumaric acid shows promising potential as an anti-inflammatory agent by effectively targeting cytosolic phospholipase A2 (cPLA2) with fewer side effects than traditional NSAIDs.

supplements.title: Molecular insights into atopic dermatitis treatment: investigating bioactive compounds in Aceh's traditional fermented coconut oil.
supplements.summary: Molecular docking revealed a compound in Aceh's fermented coconut oil could potentially inhibit inflammatory proteins associated with atopic dermatitis.

supplements.title: Potential protective role of soluble fiber in mitigating tinnitus symptoms: A case-control study.

supplements.title: Mechanism and application of hyperbaric oxygen therapy in neurosurgery.
supplements.summary: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy shows promising clinical benefits for treating various neurosurgical conditions, including brain trauma, stroke, infections, and tumors.

supplements.title: Nano-purpurin-Cu delivery via TPGS-induced macropinocytosis enables cuproptosis/metabolic synergy to ablate cancer stemness and Boost immunotherapy in colorectal cancer.
supplements.summary: Nano-purpurin-copper nanoparticles in colorectal cancer enhance drug delivery, disrupt cancer stem cells, and boost immune response through multiple coordinated mechanisms.

supplements.title: Addressing the distressing: Pancreatic enzyme replacement therapy mitigates abdominal symptoms and weight loss during chemotherapy for advanced pancreatic cancer: A prospective study.
supplements.summary: Pancreatic enzyme replacement therapy reduced abdominal symptoms and prevented weight loss in patients undergoing chemotherapy for advanced pancreatic cancer.

supplements.title: Gecko protein F2 inhibits tumor angiogenesis by suppressing the VEGF/MAPK/ERK signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Gecko protein F2 inhibits lung cancer tumor growth by blocking blood vessel formation and suppressing key molecular signaling pathways in tumor cells.

off_label.title: Metal-Supramolecular Drug Delivery System Empowered Meningeal Lymphatic Vessels-Bridged Intracranial-Peripheral Dual Immune Modulation for Reversing Glioblastoma Immune Suppression.
off_label.summary: A novel nanoassembly system delivers cancer-fighting drugs to glioblastoma through brain lymphatic vessels, reprogramming immune cells and enhancing tumor-fighting responses.

off_label.title: 3D Bioprinted Fat-Myocardium Model Unravels the Role of Adipocyte Hypertrophy in Atrial Dysfunction.
off_label.summary: A 3D bioprinted model using patient-derived fat and heart cells reveals how obesity-induced fat cell enlargement impairs heart function and identifies metformin as a potential treatment.

off_label.title: Beta-blockers improve neurological outcomes of cerebral cavernous malformations: a systematic review.
off_label.summary: Beta-blockers significantly reduced brain lesion complications and neurological risks in patients with cerebral cavernous malformations.

off_label.title: Clinical impact of high-dose esomeprazole-amoxicillin dual therapy as rescue treatment for Helicobacter pylori infection: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
off_label.summary: High-dose esomeprazole-amoxicillin dual therapy showed improved effectiveness in treating Helicobacter pylori infection, potentially offering a better rescue treatment against antibiotic-resistant strains.

off_label.title: The addition of celecoxib enhances the therapeutic benefit of cabozantinib and anti-PD1 in hepatocellular carcinoma.
off_label.summary: In a mouse model of liver cancer, combining cabozantinib, celecoxib, and anti-PD1 therapy significantly suppressed tumor growth and metastasis.

off_label.title: A robust RNAi nanoplatform for precise activation of cGAS-STING pathway and effective immune checkpoint blockade to potentiate cancer immunotherapy.
off_label.summary: A nanoplatform targeting Carm1 and using metformin precisely activates the cGAS-STING pathway, enhancing breast cancer immunotherapy by stimulating immune responses.

off_label.title: Thrombo-inflammation and Rethinking the Role of Aspirin in Kawasaki Disease.
off_label.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

Researchers examine how aspirin might help reduce inflammation and prevent coronary artery damage in children with Kawasaki Disease.

off_label.title: Assessment of adverse effects attributed to statin therapy in product labels: a meta-analysis of double-blind randomised controlled trials.
off_label.summary: A comprehensive review of double-blind clinical trials found that some reported adverse effects of statins on product labels may be overstated or not statistically supported.

off_label.title: Antihistamines Improve the Survival of Lung Cancer: A 10-Year Cohort Study of Tertiary Hospital in Taiwan.
off_label.summary: In this study, lung cancer patients taking antihistamines showed improved survival rates compared to those not using these medications.

off_label.title: Nano-purpurin-Cu delivery via TPGS-induced macropinocytosis enables cuproptosis/metabolic synergy to ablate cancer stemness and Boost immunotherapy in colorectal cancer.
off_label.summary: Nano-purpurin-copper nanoparticles in colorectal cancer enhance drug delivery, disrupt cancer stem cells, and boost immune response through multiple coordinated mechanisms.

off_label.title: Repurposing biosimilars, rethinking costs: a framework for sustainable drug pricing for repurposed bevacizumab for intravitreal injections.
off_label.summary: A novel framework suggests pricing for repurposed bevacizumab in ophthalmology ranges from €73 to €177 per injection, balancing research costs with healthcare affordability.

off_label.title: Fenofibrate potentiates the therapeutic efficacy of EZH2 inhibitors on melanoma via TRIM21- and OTUD4-mediated EZH2 ubiquitination.
off_label.summary: In melanoma, combining fenofibrate with EZH2 inhibitors improves cancer treatment by modulating fatty acid metabolism and enhancing drug effectiveness.

off_label.title: Preclinical activity of brincidofovir in peripheral T-cell and NK/T-cell lymphoma.
off_label.summary:
Here's a clear summary sentence:

Brincidofovir showed promising anti-cancer effects against T-cell and NK/T-cell lymphoma by targeting both viral and tumor mechanisms.

off_label.title: Icaritin enhances the antitumor efficacy of irinotecan by dual-targeting carboxylesterase 2 and p53 in vitro and in vivo.
off_label.summary: Icaritin boosts irinotecan's cancer-fighting effectiveness by activating CES2 and p53, potentially reducing chemotherapy drug resistance.

off_label.title: Nanozymes subvert pharmacological conventions: insights from counteracting the placental side effects of TiO₂ nanozymes.
off_label.summary: Titanium dioxide nanozymes during pregnancy can restrict fetal growth and disrupt placental metabolism, with potential interventions showing complex and unpredictable effects.

biomarkers.title: Convergence for Inactivation of TGF-β Signaling Is a Common Feature of Advanced Pancreatic Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: In advanced pancreatic cancer, TGF-β pathway inactivation varies between locally advanced and metastatic tumors, revealing distinct genetic mechanisms of disease progression.

biomarkers.title: Engineered TIGIT-Blockade Membrane Vesicles Synergize with Microwave Ablation to Mediate Liver Metastases Eradication.
biomarkers.summary: Engineered membrane vesicles targeting TIGIT and blocking blood vessel growth significantly reduced liver metastasis and improved survival after microwave ablation.

biomarkers.title: Metal-Supramolecular Drug Delivery System Empowered Meningeal Lymphatic Vessels-Bridged Intracranial-Peripheral Dual Immune Modulation for Reversing Glioblastoma Immune Suppression.
biomarkers.summary: A novel nanoassembly system delivers cancer-fighting drugs to glioblastoma through brain lymphatic vessels, reprogramming immune cells and enhancing tumor-fighting responses.

biomarkers.title: Targeting PRKCN, an Essential Driver Orchestrating mTOR-IRF4 Axis Independently of Kinase Activity, in Multiple Myeloma.
biomarkers.summary: In multiple myeloma, targeting PRKCN disrupts a critical NF-κB-mTOR-IRF4 signaling circuit, inhibiting cancer cell growth and overcoming drug resistance.

biomarkers.title: OCIAD2 Stabilizes Integrin β1 Signaling Through SNX17-Mediated Endosomal Recycling to Lipid Rafts and Modulates Cisplatin Response in HNSCC.
biomarkers.summary: In head and neck cancer, OCIAD2 helps cancer cells resist cisplatin by stabilizing a specific protein that promotes cell survival and drug resistance.

biomarkers.title: Integrating Spatial Proteogenomics in Cancer Research.
biomarkers.summary:
Here's a summary sentence:

Researchers developed a new method that maps protein and genetic changes in cancer tumors, revealing complex interactions within the tumor environment.

biomarkers.title: 3D Bioprinted Fat-Myocardium Model Unravels the Role of Adipocyte Hypertrophy in Atrial Dysfunction.
biomarkers.summary: A 3D bioprinted model using patient-derived fat and heart cells reveals how obesity-induced fat cell enlargement impairs heart function and identifies metformin as a potential treatment.

biomarkers.title: DRD2 Deficiency Underlies Pituitary Adenoma Dependent on Escherichia coli Translocation from the Gut.
biomarkers.summary: DRD2 deficiency enables E. coli gut bacteria to enter the pituitary gland, trigger inflammation, and promote pituitary adenoma development.

biomarkers.title: ZBTB21 Is a Dual Suppressor of Pyroptosis and MHC-I Antigen Presentation That Promotes Tumor Immune Evasion.
biomarkers.summary: In cancer research, blocking ZBTB21 triggers cell death and enhances immune recognition, potentially improving immunotherapy responses by overcoming tumor immune evasion mechanisms.

biomarkers.title: Patient-Derived 3D-Bioprinted Intrahepatic Cholangiocarcinoma Models Recapitulate Tumor Autologous Traits and Predict Personalized Adjuvant Therapy.
biomarkers.summary: A 3D-printed model of bile duct cancer can accurately predict drug responses, potentially guiding personalized treatment within 10 days of testing.

biomarkers.title: LncRNA CCAT2 role in female-related cancer progression and diagnosis: a comprehensive review.
biomarkers.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

CCAT2, an oncogenic long RNA, plays a critical role in promoting multiple female-related cancers by activating key cellular growth pathways.

biomarkers.title: Monitoring cancer-related fatigue and quality of life in breast and prostate cancer patients after primary treatment: a study protocol for the REBECCA trials in Norway.
biomarkers.summary: The REBECCA project aims to monitor cancer-related fatigue in breast and prostate cancer patients by using wearables, online behavior, and self-reported data to improve patient care and understanding.

biomarkers.title: AHNAK2 exacerbates the malignant phenotype of gastric cancer through activation of the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway.
biomarkers.summary: In gastric cancer, the protein AHNAK2 promotes tumor growth and spread by activating a specific cellular signaling pathway.

biomarkers.title: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) affects relative embryo morphokinetics observed by time-lapse imaging: an observational study.
biomarkers.summary:

Time-lapse imaging revealed that women with PCOS have different embryo development patterns compared to women without the syndrome.
